# IdiomFeatureVectorization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of converting idiomatic expressions into sparse feature vectors that capture syntactic, semantic, and cultural attributes for graph construction. Enables neuromorphic encoding of linguistic features, allowing in-network spike-based processing of idiomatic knowledge.
